title: Data Engineer
description:
Hello from RE Partners!

Who We Are: We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.

The 3 G’s of RE:

“Get Shit Done.”

“Get Over Shit.”

“Give a Shit.”


Senior Data Engineer


This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus


Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

This role exists to drive value for our customers and business functions through effective data engineering, modelling, and data transformations by leading the delivery of strategic data solutions whilst setting up resilient data architecture and engineering foundations and supporting junior members of the data engineering team.


Responsible for:

  • Leading the design and orchestration of modularized, automated, event-driven data engineering pipelines and data modeling approaches.
  • Building in quality by design into data engineering practices, enabling a scalable and flexible data architecture and feature rich dataset to support the wider Data function and the entire business.
  • Implementing modern code development and data engineering orchestration strategies to target and streamline our data engineering processes.
  • Embedding new data techniques into the business through coaching, training, and providing experiment design oversight to more junior data engineers.
  • Working with third party partners and software providers to improve and/or implement new data solutions and processes.
  • Being the gatekeeper for customer data, aware of our usage and alignment to data privacy standards, in collaboration with Data Governance to ensure best practice standards are applied/maintained.


Accountable for:

  • Working closely with our Lead Data and ML Engineers to drive the adoption of DevOps and modern code development practices across the Data function.
  • Collaborating with Quality and Software Engineering and System teams to drive cross-function visibility and reduction of technical debt across the teams.
  • Ensuring that our data engineering processes and pipelines are resilient and future-proof.
  • Developing a strong knowledge of all data sources and maintaining relationships with data users/processors across the company.
  • Being a Senior Data Engineer, supporting more junior data engineering colleagues from a technical skills development perspective.


Essential skills and experience:

  • Extensive expertise of RDBMS, Python, Hadoop, SQL and Pyspark.
  • GCP experience, including Dataproc and Dataflow
  • Hands on Java experience
  • Hands on experience in modern code development practices (Infrastructure-as-Code) and data engineering in the Google Cloud
  • Experience of ETL/ELT technical design, automated testing of engineering pipelines, quality assurance and documentation.
  • Proven experience of data warehousing, data wrangling and data modelling approaches.
  • Proven experience coaching junior members of data engineering teams and supporting their skills development.
  • Proven experience working collaboratively with System, Quality Engineering and Software Engineering teams.
  • Demonstrable experience of critical thinking, communication and problem-solving ability and stakeholder management
  • Demonstrate delivery under pressure and to deadline.
  • Experience working in an e-commerce/retail market would be beneficial.


Preferred skills and experience:

  • Willingness to learn new tools and techniques; proactively keeping up to date with latest thinking and practices.
  • Able to establish what does/doesn’t align to business/functional strategies/priorities and communicate dependencies clearly.
  • Able to drive the adoption of best practice approaches to data engineering, coaching, and supporting the wider data engineering team.
  • Embrace change with a positive outlook.
  • Confident to challenge, and receptive to being challenged.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.



Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

To learn more about how we can supercharge progress for you, visit


Are you an experienced SAP Basis Consultant ready to take the next step in your career? Join our Cloud Architect Advisory (CAA) team as a SAP Cloud Architect, where you'll guide customers through their SAP RISE journey and shape the future of enterprise landscapes.


About the Role


As a SAP Cloud Architect, you’ll be the strategic advisor for customers transitioning to the SAP RISE platform. This customer-facing role involves planning, designing, and presenting SAP landscape architectures tailored to each client’s needs and hyperscaler preferences (AWS, Azure, GCP). You’ll collaborate closely with SAP Sales and Account Executives to ensure technical accuracy and optimal design.


Note: This is a purely architectural role—no hands-on implementation required.


What You’ll Gain


Exposure to cutting-edge SAP technologies: S/4HANA, HANA DB, MDG, Ariba, Salesforce, and more.

Access to SAP’s internal training and learning resources.

Experience across multiple industries and customer landscapes.

A unique opportunity to work on diverse architecture setups not typically available in standard SAP Basis roles.

title: Executivo(a) de Parcerias - Cyber Security
description:
Executivo(a) de Parcerias – Cyber Security (Remuneração 100% comissionada)


Sobre a A2TM


A A2TM é uma corretora consultiva especializada no atendimento a empresas e organizações que buscam soluções de seguros com alto padrão técnico e suporte estratégico.


Atuamos em colaboração com a Gallagher , uma das maiores corretoras de seguros e resseguros do mundo, o que nos permite oferecer uma estrutura de proteção robusta, trazendo soluções que atendem nossos clientes antes, durante e após possíveis ataques digitais.


Nosso trabalho é entender profundamente os riscos e as necessidades de cada cliente , desenvolvendo programas de seguros personalizados que protegem seus ativos, fortaleçam suas operações e geram segurança de longo prazo. Relações pautadas pela ética, proximidade e alto valor de entrega são valores inegociáveis em nossa cultura de atuação.


Se você possui relacionamento com empresas que lidam com dados sensíveis, infraestrutura digital crítica ou operações expostas a riscos cibernéticos, esta pode ser uma grande oportunidade..


Sobre a vaga


Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com networking corporativo sólido e visão estratégica para atuar na captação de empresas com demanda por seguros cibernéticos.


Trata-se de uma parceria comissionada , ideal para quem já possui entrada em empresas que buscam soluções robustas de proteção digital, como:


  • Escritórios de advocacia
  • Clínicas e hospitais
  • Empresas de tecnologia e software
  • E-commerces
  • Fintechs e instituições financeiras
  • Indústrias com sistemas digitais críticos
  • Grupos empresariais


Quem buscamos


-Profissional com perfil comercial e consultivo;


-Profissional com histórico de atuação na área de Cyber Security de grandes empresas;


-Forte rede de contatos em áreas como:

  • Tecnologia
  • Compliance
  • Jurídico
  • Finanças
  • Saúde
  • Varejo digital
  • Indústrias de dados


Escopo de Atuação


  • Mapear empresas com risco ou exposição a incidentes cibernéticos
  • Abrir canais de comunicação com estas empresas
  • Agendar reuniões para apresentação dos serviços e soluções do Seguro Cibernético
  • Acompanhar a evolução das negociações e manter relacionamento próximo com o cliente


O que oferecemos


  • Comissões atrativas por produção
  • Suporte de uma equipe especializada em Seguro Cibernético
  • Desenvolvimento e crescimento no setor de securetário, que representa quase 7% do pib brasileiro


Posição 100% comissionada


Buscamos parceiros(as) com visão comercial e capacidade de desenvolver novos negócios . Se você se identifica com esse perfil, será um prazer conhece-lo.

title: Manager, Site Strategy & Engagement
description:
Established in 1996 and rebranded to Scout in 2024, we built our foundation on planning meetings for numerous organizations within the life sciences sector (Scout Meetings). In response to emerging industry needs, we expanded our services to include Scout Clinical, one of the top providers of clinical trial patient travel and reimbursements, and Scout Academy, our secure, online, on-demand learning management system that ensures global compliance.


Scout is recognized as a leader in our field for innovation in service, attention to detail, our stellar team members, and making the complex easier. If this interests you, we’d love to have you join our rapidly growing team!


Position Summary:

The Manager of Site Strategy and Engagement is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with clinical research sites, ensuring successful site engagement, and performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. This role involves collaborating with clinical operations teams, ensuring the utilization of the services scoped, and working to enhance site satisfaction and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:

  • Site Engagement: Identify, assess, and engage with potential clinical research sites in studies contracted to use Scout services, ensuring they are aware of the service and have everything needed to optimize use of the portal.
  • Site Support: Provide guidance and direction to sites and operations team members to drive strategy for continued use of the portal.
  • Site/Study Utilization Monitoring: Monitor site utilization throughout the trial, ensuring portal use and proactively addressing any issues or concerns that may arise at the site level.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Project Managers, Patient Lesions, Site staff, and sponsors, to ensure alignment on site-related needs.
  • Site Relationship Management: Cultivate long-term, productive relationships with clinical sites. Regularly check in with sites to assess their needs, gather feedback, and improve site engagement strategies.
  • Problem Solving & Issue Resolution: Anticipate, identify, and resolve any issues or obstacles at the site level to ensure continued use of the portal.
  • Regional Client Support: Support client conversations with regional specific expertise. Gather local market insights including challenges and recommend how Scout can best support or solve them.
  • Marketing for the region: Support marketing with drafting messaging with an emphasis on local, cultural, economic and regulatory considerations.
  • Complete all required initial and ongoing training within a reasonable or provided timeframe.


The ideal candidate will have the following experience, skills, and knowledge:

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Nursing, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in clinical research or clinical trial management, with a focus on site management or clinical site engagement.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial processes, regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build rapport with diverse stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple sites and projects simultaneously, with strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese (spoken and written)


Visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn for other employment opportunities.


WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

title: Manager, Site Strategy & Engagement
description:
Established in 1996 and rebranded to Scout in 2024, we built our foundation on planning meetings for numerous organizations within the life sciences sector (Scout Meetings). In response to emerging industry needs, we expanded our services to include Scout Clinical, one of the top providers of clinical trial patient travel and reimbursements, and Scout Academy, our secure, online, on-demand learning management system that ensures global compliance.


Scout is recognized as a leader in our field for innovation in service, attention to detail, our stellar team members, and making the complex easier. If this interests you, we’d love to have you join our rapidly growing team!


Position Summary:

The Manager of Site Strategy and Engagement is responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with clinical research sites, ensuring successful site engagement, and performance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle. This role involves collaborating with clinical operations teams, ensuring the utilization of the services scoped, and working to enhance site satisfaction and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities of this position include but are not limited to:

  • Site Engagement: Identify, assess, and engage with potential clinical research sites in studies contracted to use Scout services, ensuring they are aware of the service and have everything needed to optimize use of the portal.
  • Site Support: Provide guidance and direction to sites and operations team members to drive strategy for continued use of the portal.
  • Site/Study Utilization Monitoring: Monitor site utilization throughout the trial, ensuring portal use and proactively addressing any issues or concerns that may arise at the site level.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including Project Managers, Patient Lesions, Site staff, and sponsors, to ensure alignment on site-related needs.
  • Site Relationship Management: Cultivate long-term, productive relationships with clinical sites. Regularly check in with sites to assess their needs, gather feedback, and improve site engagement strategies.

  • PJ

Requisitos Mandatórios:

Experiência comprovada nos seguintes pontos:

Google Analytics (GA4): Avançado/Especialista em configuração, migração, auditoria e uso estratégico da plataforma (Relatórios Padrão e Análises Exploratórias).

- A vaga é para um profissional sênior em análise de dados, atuando como referência técnica no ecossistema Google para insights estratégicos em uma plataforma AutoTech B2B global.

- O foco é na integração de web analytics (GA4) com big data (GCP/BigQuery), impulsionando decisões em marketing, produto e operações com dados massivos de comportamento de usuários e transações automotivas (ex.: insights de compra/venda de veículos).

- O papel é de alto impacto, exigindo liderança técnica em governança de dados e comunicação executive.

Se interessou, encaminhe seu currículo também para:


Requisitos Mandatórios:

Experiência comprovada nos seguintes pontos:

Google Analytics (GA4): Avançado/Especialista em configuração, migração, auditoria e uso estratégico da plataforma (Relatórios Padrão e Análises Exploratórias).

Google Cloud Platform (GCP): Familiaridade sólida com a plataforma GCP, incluindo Cloud Storage e IAM.

- A vaga é para um profissional sênior em análise de dados, atuando como referência técnica no ecossistema Google para insights estratégicos em uma plataforma AutoTech B2B global.

- O foco é na integração de web analytics (GA4) com big data (GCP/BigQuery), impulsionando decisões em marketing, produto e operações com dados massivos de comportamento de usuários e transações automotivas (ex.: insights de compra/venda de veículos).

- O papel é de alto impacto, exigindo liderança técnica em governança de dados e comunicação executive.

title: Portuguese Speaking  Reporter  UK / Brazil
description:
Portuguese Speaking Reporter | €35K | Remote

We’re a global media and events leader at the centre of the iGaming B2B ecosystem — covering the technology, regulation, data, platforms, and commercial engines that power online gaming worldwide. This isn’t consumer‑facing content; it’s the heartbeat of the industry.

If you’re hungry to learn, thrive in fast‑paced news, and want to grow quickly in a sector that never stands still, this is your moment.

The Role

We’re looking for a sharp, ambitious Reporter to join our newsroom and help shape our editorial voice across Europe and Brazil.

You’ll cover daily iGaming news, support senior journalists, and—crucially—develop original stories that go beyond recycled press releases. This is an ideal first step for someone building a journalism career and eager to develop deep industry expertise.

What You’ll Do

  • Write and publish accurate, timely news across regulation, M&A, product launches, and market trends
  • Review, edit, and publish press releases for our B2B News Support package
  • Maintain high editorial standards, sourcing, and attribution
  • Optimise headlines, metadata, and internal linking
  • Build a source tracker and grow toward original reporting, exclusives, and first‑hand stories
  • Produce 4–6 high‑quality stories per week , with a focus on originality, insight, and fresh angles
  • Help shape our brand voice and act as a strong editorial ambassador
  • Contribute to educating and expanding our presence in the Brazilian market

What You Bring

  • Journalism or editorial experience
  • Fluent Portuguese (essential)
  • Proven experience in the iGaming sector (essential)
  • Strong grammar, accuracy, and headline instincts
  • Ability to turn press releases into engaging B2B news
  • Organised, reliable, and deadline‑driven
  • Based in the UK

What Sets You Apart

  • Strong iGaming industry contacts and a passion for uncovering first‑hand stories
  • Curiosity, motivation, and the confidence to pursue stories even when they challenge industry narratives
  • SEO knowledge
  • Ambition to build sources and break stories

What’s In It for You

  • Ownership of our Press Release Support product
  • Fast progression toward explainers, features, and exclusives
  • A real opportunity to shape editorial identity and influence a fast‑growing brand

Benefits

  • Private health insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programme & retail discounts
  • Flexible, remote‑friendly working

Why Join Us

You’ll be part of a fast‑growing, ambitious team where your work is seen, valued, and genuinely impactful. We champion curiosity, initiative, and growth — and we’ll support you in becoming a trusted voice in iGaming journalism, with a meaningful role in shaping how the industry is understood across Europe and Brazil.

title: Technical Trainer
description:
Technical Trainer (Consultant) – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for 119 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.


CAS is seeking an independent consultant to deliver technical training and product consulting services for CAS scientific information solutions in Latin America (based in Brazil). This is a contract-based engagement.


The consultant will provide pre- and post-sale technical training and product consulting to users of CAS solutions, including SciFinder, BioFinder, and STNext, with a focus on Life Sciences content.


Services will include:

Training & Enablement

  • Prepare and deliver instructional materials for technical training events, user meetings, and conferences.
  • Conduct on-site and virtual sessions to educate customers on CAS solutions and best practices.
  • Design customized educational content tailored to customer workflows and needs.

Consultative Support

  • Provide product consulting to help customers maximize adoption and value.
  • Collaborate with ACS International teams as needed to align training with strategic objectives.
  • Offer insights on AI-driven features and innovative functionalities within CAS solutions.

Customer Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and continuous learning for CAS users.
  • Gather feedback and communicate actionable insights to ACS International for product improvement.
  • Support initiatives that promote customer success and solution optimization.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations at workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed under the engagement.


Required Expertise:

  • Proven experience in designing and delivering technical training programs.
  • Strong ability to simplify and communicate complex scientific concepts.
  • Familiarity with CAS solutions (SciFinder, STNext) and other scientific information platforms.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Skilled in virtual training tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx) and CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX).


Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a related discipline (preferred focus on drug discovery or pharmaceutical development).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in technical training, customer success, or product consulting.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.


This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.


To apply for this consulting position, please submit your cover letter and CV to

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer


About the Role


We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join a high-impact engineering team working on a large-scale, enterprise-grade, multi-tenant web platform.

In this role, you will build and maintain a sophisticated web application using modern technologies, contributing to a codebase that prioritizes performance, scalability, code quality, and exceptional user experience .



Technical Stack - Core Technologies


  • Frontend: React 18, Next.js 14 (Pages Router), TypeScript
  • Styling: Linaria (CSS-in-JS)
  • State Management: React Context API
  • Backend/API: Next.js API Routes, Node.js
  • Headless CMS: Contentstack
  • Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress (E2E)
  • Build Tools: Webpack 5, Babel, Yarn 4 (Workspaces)

Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, ECR, Route53, ALB)
  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Monitoring: Elastic APM
  • Caching: Redis
  • Analytics: mParticle, Adobe Target


Key Responsibilities - Development


  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js
  • Build and maintain reusable, well-typed component libraries with comprehensive test coverage
  • Integrate and manage content delivery workflows using a headless CMS


Code Quality & Best Practices


  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established standards (strict TypeScript, ESLint, Stylelint)
  • Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive, high-quality feedback
  • Follow accessibility standards and best practices in semantic HTML


Collaboration


  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and engineering teams
  • Mentor junior engineers and lead technical knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and technical design discussions
  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to architectural decision records


Required Qualifications - Experience


  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
  • 2+ years working with Next.js or similar SSR frameworks
  • Strong experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and Node.js
  • Experience with CSS-in-JS solutions (Linaria, Styled Components, or similar)
  • Proven experience building and maintaining large-scale web applications
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms


Technical Skills


  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript with strict typing
  • Strong understanding of React hooks, Context API, and component lifecycle
  • Experience with modern build tools such as Webpack and Babel
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services
  • Proficiency with Git and command-line workflows
  • Strong testing mindset with experience in Jest, React Testing Library, and E2E testing


Soft Skills


  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical challenges
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts
  • High attention to detail and strong commitment to code quality
  • Ability to balance technical debt and feature delivery in a fast-paced environment


Nice to Have


  • Experience in regulated or enterprise-scale platforms
  • Knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
  • Experience building design systems and component libraries
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6)
  • Experience using Storybook for component documentation
  • Knowledge of analytics platforms (mParticle, Adobe)
  • Experience with blue-green deployments
  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards

title: Founder Associate (Growth)
description:
Location: Brazil (remote-first, with collaboration across Europe & Latin America)

Languages: English (fluent), Portuguese (fluent), Spanish (plus)


About OpenHealth

OpenHealth is building the infrastructure layer for health data , harmonizing and enriching laboratory results to power clinics, labs, insurers, and health-tech companies across Europe and Latin America. Our mission is to unlock the full value of medical data to enable better clinical decisions, preventive care, and AI-driven health innovation.

In 2025 OpenHealth raised it’s second institutional investment round, invested by selected leading Venture Capital firms from Europe:


What You Will Do

As Founder Associate , you will work directly with our CEO and act as a force multiplier across strategy, growth, project execution, operations, and fundraising . You will take full ownership of strategic initiatives , from definition to execution, and ensure that the most important projects move fast and deliver impact.

On a typical day, you may:

  • Lead high-impact strategic projects end-to-end with full ownership, such as new market entries, launch of new products, or strategic partnerships
  • Own project management for cross-functional initiatives, including scoping, timelines, stakeholder alignment, execution tracking, and delivery
  • Drive cross-functional programs across product, tech, growth, operations, and external partners
  • Support enterprise clients and strategic partners , including preparation of proposals, business cases, and pilots
  • Prepare board- and investor-ready presentations, decision memos, KPIs, and performance reports
  • Conduct market, competitor, customer, and investor research to support strategic decisions and positioning
  • Improve and scale internal processes and workflows , leveraging automation and AI where possible
  • Support fundraising and investor relations , including pitch materials, data rooms, investor outreach, and follow-ups
  • Act as a sparring partner to the CEO , helping prioritize initiatives, challenge assumptions, and execute across multiple workstreams simultaneously


Who You Are

You are a high-ownership, execution-focused strategic generalist who enjoys operating close to decision-making and turning strategy into results.

Your profile likely includes:

  • A degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Medicine , or a similarly analytical field
  • 1–3 years of high-impact professional experience , e.g. in management consulting, investment banking, VC/PE, Big Tech, health-tech, or an early-stage venture-backed startup
  • Demonstrated experience in project management , owning complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders from planning to execution
  • A clear track record of leading strategic projects under full ownership , such as new market entries, international expansion, or go-to-market initiatives
  • Strong analytical and structured thinking , with the ability to turn complex problems into clear, actionable plans
  • Proven ability to work directly with C-level executives , driving initiatives with measurable impact
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability – you proactively identify problems and deliver solutions
  • Comfort operating in fast-paced, high-pressure environments with shifting priorities
  • Known for being reliable, persistent, and outcome-driven , with a strong bias toward execution


What Matters to Us

  • Strong motivation for the health industry , ideally with first exposure to healthcare, health-tech, life sciences, or medical data
  • Interest in how technology, data, and AI can meaningfully improve healthcare systems and patient outcomes
  • Ability to communicate effectively across business, technical, and medical stakeholders
  • A mindset of ownership, learning, and long-term impact


Languages & Location

  • English: Fluent
  • Portuguese: Fluent
  • Spanish: Plus / nice to have
  • Location: Brazil - São Paulo or Florianopolis (working closely with teams and partners in Europe & Latin America)


Why Join OpenHealth?

  • Work directly with the founders on company-defining initiatives
  • Take full ownership of strategic projects with visible impact
  • Exposure to international markets, enterprise clients, and investors
  • Steep learning curve across health-tech, data, AI, and B2B SaaS
  • Clear growth path into senior strategy, operations, or leadership roles

title: M&A Advisor
description:
Expanda sua Prática de M&A: Una-se à Rede Internacional da ONEtoONE Corporate Finance


Conecte sua expertise ao mercado global. Transforme sua assessoria local em uma potência internacional.


A ONEtoONE Corporate Finance Group convida assessores de M&A e boutiques independentes de renome no Brasil a integrarem nossa rede global. Combinamos tecnologia de ponta, colaboração internacional e um back office completo para potencializar sua originação e execução de deals no middle-market.


Quem Somos


Somos uma rede internacional de investment banking especializada em assessoria de M&A para o middle-market. Conectamos mais de 150 assessores em mais de 80 cidades ao redor do mundo, com foco em transações cross-border.


Nota Importante: Esta é uma oportunidade de Membership (Afiliação) para profissionais e firmas independentes; não se trata de uma vaga de emprego (CLT) ou prestação de serviços terceirizados.


Ferramentas e Suporte de Classe Mundial


Ao longo de duas décadas, a ONEtoONE investiu no desenvolvimento de ferramentas exclusivas que permitem aos nossos membros:


  • Originação de Elite: Conquiste mais e melhores mandatos.
  • Inteligência de Mercado: Identifique compradores ou targets ideais globalmente.
  • Back Office Dedicado: Suporte em todas as fases — desde o pitch e análise financeira até a documentação e busca de contrapartes.
  • Dados Premium: Acesso a perfis de mais de 450 milhões de empresas e dados de transações globais.


Colaboração Sem Fronteiras


No Brasil, o relacionamento é a base de tudo. Nossa rede permite que você colabore com especialistas em diversos setores e países sem restrições geográficas ou setoriais. Você terá a liberdade de operar globalmente, utilizando ferramentas de IA e bancos de dados proprietários para multiplicar seu alcance e sua receita.


Perfil Ideal


Buscamos profissionais brasileiros com o seguinte perfil:


  • Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em Corporate Finance, Private Equity, M&A ou assessoria transacional.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado/fluente (essencial para colaboração internacional).
  • Mindset: Perfil empreendedor, proativo e orientado a resultados.
  • Expertise: Forte rede de relacionamentos local e capacidade analítica.
  • Visão: Desejo de portar uma marca global de investment banking e trabalhar de forma colaborativa.


O Que Você Ganha


  • Suporte Full Back Office: Originadores, analistas e especialistas em marketing, jurídico e TI à sua disposição.
  • Tecnologia de Ponta: Acesso às melhores bases de dados de M&A do mundo e ferramentas de IA exclusivas.
  • Networking Global: Conexão direta com pares em 80+ cidades e especialistas setoriais.
  • Transparência: Estrutura de fee-sharing clara que valoriza o trabalho em equipe.
  • Liberdade: Autonomia total para gerir seu negócio com o suporte de uma marca global.


Pronto para elevar o nível da sua assessoria?


Se você tem a experiência e a motivação para expandir sua prática de M&A para além das fronteiras brasileiras, convidamos você a se candidatar para a rede ONEtoONE International .

title: SAP Signavio Consultant
description:
SAP Signavio Consultant – Remote

Location : LATAM

Type : Contract


Job Description

We are seeking a SAP Signavio Consultant to join our team supporting process discovery, modeling, and process intelligence using SAP Signavio tools. This position is remote from Latin America and requires working in collaboration with US‑based functional and business teams (US time zones).


Responsibilities

  • Lead process discovery and modeling using SAP Signavio across core ERP domains (O2C, P2P, R2R, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain).
  • Support life sciences‑specific process mapping.
  • Deploy and manage SAP Signavio solutions (Process Manager, Collaboration Hub, Process Intelligence).
  • Analyze process mining data and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Collaborate effectively with US teams and business stakeholders.


Required Skills

  • 4–8 years’ experience in business process management, including 2–3 years with SAP Signavio.
  • Strong understanding of life sciences operational and compliance processes.
  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA or ECC ERP processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills and experience working with US teams.
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed nearshore setup.


Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP Signavio certifications.
  • Experience in pharma, biotech, or medical devices.
  • Knowledge of SAP Activate or other business transformation methodologies.


Background Checks

Full background check, employment history, education verification for the last 7 years, and a mandatory 10‑panel drug test for selected candidates.


Interested? Apply here or reach out directly to start a conversation at

title: HR Operations Manager
description:
The HR operations manager owns the execution and continuous improvement of HR operations across the full team member lifecycle — from onboarding through offboarding. This is a hands-on role that blends operational leadership, systems ownership, and process discipline.

You will work closely with the Director of Global HR , HR Specialists, and cross-functional partners to ensure HR systems, workflows, and documentation operate smoothly and consistently across countries.

This role is centered on building, operating, and continuously elevating a high-performing HR engine, with a strong commitment to operational excellence and ongoing improvement every day.


Must haves

  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience , with a strong focus on HR operations
  • Advanced English proficiency (written and verbal)
  • Location: Ukraine, Poland, Romania
  • Experience working in technology, IT, consulting, or service-based environments
  • Proven success building, running, and improving HR processes that scale with company growth
  • Hands-on experience managing HR operations for a multi-country workforce
  • Strong experience with HRIS platforms (HiBob preferred) and modern productivity tools
  • Strong working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Google Workspace , and related collaboration tools
  • Exceptional attention to detail and operational discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions in a fast-paced, distributed environment


Nice to have

  • Experience supporting distributed, multi-country teams
  • Familiarity with SOC2, ISO, or similar compliance environments
  • Experience using AI or automation to improve HR workflows, reporting, or efficiency

title: Pessoa Analista de DP Sênior
description:
Sobre a empresa


A Oficina é parceira estratégica na criação de reputação e relacionamento, por meio de histórias e causas que transformam o país.


Em 2025 lançamos um novo modelo de negócios que integra a agilidade de uma agência, a profundidade estratégica de uma consultoria e a força de uma atuação em rede.

Nesse contexto, nasceu a Rede de Reputação e Influência , a primeira Community as a Service (CaaS) de Reputação e Influência do Brasil. A iniciativa reúne 40 empresas parceiras com atuação regional e nacional, combinando tecnologia, inteligência e colaboração para antecipar cenários e apoiar decisões com agilidade e precisão.


Nos pautamos em valores como respeito, diversidade, inquietude, ética, excelência no atendimento e trabalho em equipe. Nosso ambiente de trabalho é colaborativo, inovador e orientado a resultados, com modelo híbrido, plano de carreira estruturado e investimento contínuo no desenvolvimento de pessoas.


Responsabilidade e atribuições


  • Executar e consolidar a folha de pagamento;
  • Conferir encargos e recolhimentos;
  • Executar admissões e rescisões complexas;
  • Controlar obrigações recorrentes;
  • Gerar relatórios operacionais e gerenciais;
  • Orientar tecnicamente a equipe;
  • Atender auditorias operacionais;
  • Manter controles e documentações atualizadas.


Requisitos e qualificações


Graduação em Administração de Empresas, Gestão de RH ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência com: Lançamentos de dados, verificação e fechamento da folha de pagamento, encerramento dos encargos mensais (FGTS, INSS, IRRF), processamento dos relatórios gerenciais da folha, contabilização, provisionamento, 13º salário, suporte em gestão de benefícios, controle de ponto, rescisão e férias, aplicação da CLT e CCT, envio de leiautes e fechamento do SPED e-Social, DCTF Web, RPA, tratamento de afastamentos pelo INSS, envio das obrigações anuais - DIRF e outras rotinas pertinentes à área de administração de pessoal.


Aqui, o compromisso com a diversidade e inclusão é transversal à estratégia da empresa: todas as vagas são destinadas também a mulheres, pessoas pretas, indígenas, LGBTQIAP+, pessoas com deficiência e profissionais 40+.


Fazer parte da Oficina é integrar um time que constrói, de forma ética, inovadora e colaborativa, a Nova Era da Reputação e Influência no Brasil.

description:
Company - RONIN International is an independent B2B market research company specialising in business, healthcare and tech studies. We are part of the Rippleffect Group (formerly Fat Media Group) and are Company Partners of The Market Research Society (MRS), Corporate Members of ESOMAR, Members of the Insights Association and Council Members of The Interviewer Quality Control Scheme (IQCS).



About - We are looking to speak with leaders and senior professionals —such as CEO, CFO, Director, VP, Department Head and Senior Manager .



Qualifications:

  • The purpose of this study is to gain an understanding of the global awareness of city’s attractiveness in trade, investment and partnership. I believe your opinions and expertise would be valuable for our study and I wonder if you’re interested in taking part.
  • Job titles: C-suite Executive, Partner, Director, Vice President, Head of Department and Senior Manager.
  • The paid consultancy session will be conducted as an informal 30-minute interview conducted via MS Teams and the interview can be held in either English or Portuguese.
  • Please note that, before the final interview, there'll be a 10-minute quick online screener to share more details on the research and to check that this is relevant to you.


Compensation package - BRL 790 for a 30-minute online interview.

title: Senior Backend Developer (Python, SDK)
description:
About Us


We’re a fully-remote company distributed across the Americas with no physical headquarters. We help companies build great products that matter - that's what defines us as a group.


We’re a developer-first software development nearshore company. We prioritize building lasting partnerships with our clients. We go beyond just delivering code, we proactively bring forward solutions for challenging problems. Whether in our team augmentation model or our project model, we are dedicated to our client's success.


We’re like no other outsourcing company. We create a great environment for our developers and ensure they want to stick around, rather than switch to our clients. We treat our developers with respect and provide a culture of learning and growth.


Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Backend Developer in Brazil. You will join one of our North American client's engineering team to maintain, design, implement, test, and deploy new features in their Python SDK as well as fix bugs, improve, and update its existing functionalities. As an experienced developer, you will be responsible for writing great documentation, doing demos, and mentoring others. You will participate in the client's team ceremonies and other sessions.


Must Have Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • Experience working independently and remotely.
  • Strong experience with Python.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with Public API and Python SDK on the backend implementation side.
  • Familiarity with FastAPI is a plus since one of the tasks ahead is to tighten up the client endpoints so that the developer generates well-designed and comprehensive OpenAPI specifications.
  • SDK coding for other developers


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

Rockstar, ninja, guru? No, thanks.

Friendly, hardworking, thoughtful? Yes, please.


If you are a manager of one, friendly, hardworking, thoughtful, and you care deeply about doing great work, then you'll do just fine here.


Role Description


This is a full-time remote role for a Senior Backend Developer in Brazil. You will join one of our North American client's engineering team to maintain, design, implement, test, and deploy new features in their Python SDK as well as fix bugs, improve, and update its existing functionalities. As an experienced developer, you will be responsible for writing great documentation, doing demos, and mentoring others. You will participate in the client's team ceremonies and other sessions.


Must Have Qualifications


  • Strong English communication, writing and verbal.
  • Experience working independently and remotely.
  • Strong experience with Python.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with Public API and Python SDK on the backend implementation side.
  • Familiarity with FastAPI is a plus since one of the tasks ahead is to tighten up the client endpoints so that the developer generates well-designed and comprehensive OpenAPI specifications.
  • SDK coding for other developers


What We Offer


  • This will be a PJ hire with competitive pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work.
  • Supportive environment with 1-1 mentoring and group knowledge sharing sessions.
  • International experience working with leading startups in North America.

title: Engenheiro de Dados
description:
Transforme Dados em Estratégia e Inovação!


Você é apaixonado(a) por transformar dados em ativos estratégicos para os negócios? Tem domínio de Azure, Databricks e busca desafios em projetos de grande escala? Então essa oportunidade é para você!

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para liderar o desenvolvimento e a sustentação de pipelines modernos e eficientes em ambiente cloud. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com tecnologias de ponta, colaborar com times multidisciplinares e impactar diretamente decisões estratégicas por meio de dados de qualidade.


Suas responsabilidades incluirão:


Desenhar, implementar e otimizar arquiteturas e processos de engenharia de dados, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.

Desenvolver e implementar soluções de engenharia de dados em ambiente Azure (Data Factory, Synapse

Analytics, Databricks, Data Lake, SQL Database).

Estruturar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) de alta performance e confiabilidade.

Atuar na modelagem de dados, integração de sistemas e governança da informação.

Garantir boas práticas de performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares e stakeholders internacionais.

Participar de reuniões e apresentações em inglês avançado.

title: Thumbnail Designer (Art Director)  - Crypto Media
description:
We are the world’s No.1 LIVE Crypto Streaming Channel, covering Bitcoin, breaking news, altcoins, market moves, and the biggest names in the industry — every single day. From two enthusiasts streaming from a coffee shop to one of the fastest-growing crypto media networks, we now run a consortium of top YouTube channels for live news, trading, investing, web3, and gaming, partnering with the biggest brands and advertisers in the space. Born from a career at CNBC and the world’s first televised daily crypto news show, Crypto Banter was created to break free from corporate media and lead the Media 2.0 movement for tech, finance, and crypto .Today, with 80+ team members and over 10M monthly views, we’re hungrier than ever to build the most profitable and engaged community in the world. We’re a team of enthusiasts, misfits, and entrepreneurs who work harder than anyone in the industry — driven by passion, obsession, and the pursuit of the impossible. If that sounds like you, join us!


Role Overview

Crypto Banter creates multiple design assets on a daily basis for our content platforms. These design thumbnails encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching, interesting manner and act as a marketing asset for each show. We are looking for an art director with crypto knowledge that can assist the design team in conceptualizing and executing these designs and thumbnails on a daily basis. This role requires experience and knowledge of crypto to understand stories or news events and translate that understanding into punchy, eye-catching and impactful thumbnails to be used and packaged with the content that is distributed.


What you’ll do

  • Lead and Scale the Creative Squad: Direct a high-performance design team of three, managing the end-to-end execution of daily visual assets while collaborating with the Lead Art Director to maintain \"Brilliance or Nothing\" standards.
  • Conceptualise Viral Storytelling: Translate complex crypto news, market shifts, and \"breaking\" narratives into punchy, high-CTR YouTube thumbnails that encapsulate the story in the most eye-catching and urgent manner possible.
  • Rapid News Translation & Relay: Spearhead daily morning briefing calls to digest the latest market moves and breaking stories, immediately distilling these insights into actionable creative briefs for the design team.
  • Optimise for Performance & CTR: Apply a deep understanding of YouTube’s backend mechanics and audience psychology to create assets that win the \"click\" by a mile, ensuring all packaging is impactful and market-relevant.
  • Operationalise Design Workflows: Build and maintain a seamless, efficient design process that can withstand the intense time constraints of a live streaming environment, ensuring every show asset is ready for the \"Stream Team\" before go-live.
  • Cross-Functional Creative Direction: Provide expert art direction and execution for diverse auxiliary projects across the media network, ensuring a consistent and \"elite\" visual identity across all platforms.



Your skills and experience

  • Visual Storytelling and Execution: Proven ability to turn complex crypto narratives and \"breaking\" market news into high-impact YouTube thumbnails that are simple, urgent, and designed to win the click.
  • Crypto Fluency and Market Literacy: A deep-rooted \"fellow degen\" mentality with a daily obsession for watching the charts, following altcoins, and tracking the world’s biggest market moves.
  • Creative Leadership and Briefing: Experienced in leading and managing international design teams, with the ability to relay complex daily stories into clear, actionable creative briefs for rapid execution.
  • YouTube Psychology and Backend Mastery: A strong understanding of YouTube mechanics, specifically focusing on click-through rates (CTR) and audience retention strategies used by top-tier crypto and finance channels.
  • High-Velocity Performance: Exceptional ability to work under intense pressure and tight time constraints, delivering production-ready assets for live shows on a daily basis.
  • Strategic Communication and Copywriting: Sharp copywriting skills used to craft titles and visual hooks that capture attention while maintaining transparency and brand integrity

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior (inglês fluente)

Experiência Requerida

  • Experiência recomendada: Atuação em desenvolvimento de aplicações de BI.
  • Capacidade de identificar riscos técnicos e de segurança, bem como propor ações de mitigação.
  • Experiência prática com práticas de Gerenciamento de Configuração e Liberação (Configuration & Release Management).
  • Participação em modificações de software durante os testes de integração.
  • Compreensão dos requisitos dos stakeholders e documentação desses requisitos sob orientação.
  • Propor mudanças para melhorar a eficiência e/ou reduzir custos operacionais ou de manutenção.
  • Criar boas práticas e propor melhorias.
  • Levantar requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, incluindo requisitos de segurança da informação, junto aos stakeholders, e documentá-los.

Competências Obrigatórias

  • Experiência comprovada na construção e gerenciamento de workflows de ETL e jobs no Databricks.
  • Forte expertise em Python, SQL e frameworks de processamento distribuído de dados (ex.: Spark).
  • Conhecimento prático em desenvolvimento Python.
  • Base sólida em controle de versão utilizando Git.
  • Conhecimento em pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps.
  • Entendimento de Databricks Unity Catalog, clusters e SQL Warehouses.
  • Experiência com Azure Data Factory.
  • Facilidade no uso de ferramentas de linha de comando (CLI) e scripts (ex.: Azure CLI, Databricks CLI).
  • Familiaridade com app registrations e service principals.

Competências Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento dos setores industrial, automotivo ou de logística.
  • Experiência de trabalho com equipes europeias.
  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem, como Azure Functions e Azure Web Apps.
  • Vivência em integrações de APIs e mensageria baseada em JSON.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área correlata.

Idioma:

Imprescindível inglês fluente para atuar com equipes internacionais


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Nordeste
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Nordeste



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Desenvolvedor Blue Prism Sênior (Remoto)

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.

  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada como Desenvolvedor Blue Prism;
  • Domínio avançado de Process Studio, Object Studio, Exception Handling, Work Queues e Session Management;
  • Forte experiência na criação de objetos reutilizáveis e escaláveis;
  • Experiência com integração de sistemas APIs / Web Services (REST e SOAP);
  • Manipulação e tratamento de arquivos: Excel, CSV, PDF, TXT, XML, JSON;
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL para consultas e validações;
  • Experiência em ambientes produtivos críticos, alta volumetria de processos e atuação com SLAs;
  • Vivência com versionamento de código, controle de mudanças e boas práticas de deploy;
  • Conhecimento em ITIL (incidentes, problemas e mudanças);
  • Capacidade de análise de logs e troubleshooting avançado;
  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de automação;
  • Conhecimento em Cloud (Azure ou similar);
  • Noções de arquitetura de soluções e segurança da informação;
  • Experiência com pipelines / DevOps e integração com sistemas legados e ERPs;
  • Certificações Blue Prism;
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Visão de Dono;
  • Foco no Cliente;
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva;
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Autonomia e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Perfil proativo e orientado à melhoria contínua;
  • Organização e gestão de prioridades;
  • Capacidade de atuar sob pressão e em cenários críticos;
  • Postura madura para tomada de decisão técnica;
  • Facilidade para trabalhar em ambientes de mudança e transição;
  • Espírito colaborativo e capacidade de mentoria técnica.

title: Business Intelligence Specialist (Remoto)
description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo.

Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics.

Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Vaga Analista BI & Data Visualization - Sênior


O que oferecemos a você:

  • Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares
  • Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas
  • Auxílio creche
  • Seguro de vida
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês
  • Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas
  • Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias
  • Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis


O que esperar desta posição:


Competências Técnicas Obrigatórias:

  • SQL Avançado - consultas complexas, otimização e grandes volumes de dados
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de BI (Power BI ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em estatística aplicada - análise descritiva, inferencial e modelagem preditiva
  • Vivência com processos de ETL , integração e limpeza de dados
  • Excel Avançado - tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas e análise de dados


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Python ou R para análises estatísticas e automação
  • Experiência com modelagem preditiva e machine learning básico
  • Domínio em design de dashboards e storytelling com dados
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e data warehouses


Responsabilidades Principais:

• Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI

• Realizar consultas SQL complexas para extração e análise de dados

• Garantir qualidade, integridade e consistência dos dados

• Apoiar na definição e monitoramento de KPIs e métricas operacionais

• Criar modelos estatísticos e análises preditivas

• Trabalhar com equipes de operações para identificar oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados

• Realizar análises estatísticas para suporte à tomada de decisão


Perfil do Candidato:

• Mentalidade analítica e orientada a dados

• Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights acionáveis

• Habilidades de comunicação para apresentar resultados

• Atenção a detalhes e precisão nos dados

• Proatividade na identificação de oportunidades


O que oferecemos:

• Oportunidade de atuar em projetos estratégicos

• Ambiente com foco em data-driven decision making

• Acesso a ferramentas modernas de BI e análise

• Plano de desenvolvimento profissional contínuo

• Benefícios competitivos de mercado

• Trabalho com grandes volumes de dados e desafios complexos


O que esperamos de você:


Ensino superior completo em TI ou áreas correlatas;


Se você acha que possui 75% ou até 90% do que estamos procurando e sabe que é capaz das responsabilidades e deveres desta função, encorajamos você a se candidatar! Isso mostrará sua disposição a se desenvolver, curiosidade para aprender e crescer profissional e pessoalmente.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.


Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail

description:
A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo.

Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics.

Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:


Vaga Analista BI & Data Visualization - Sênior


O que oferecemos a você:

  • Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares
  • Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares
  • Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição
  • Auxílio home office para vaga remota
  • Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas
  • Auxílio creche
  • Seguro de vida
  • Parceria com instituições de ensino
  • Parceria com escolas de idiomas
  • Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês
  • Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas
  • Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias
  • Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis


O que esperar desta posição:


Competências Técnicas Obrigatórias:

  • SQL Avançado - consultas complexas, otimização e grandes volumes de dados
  • Experiência sólida com ferramentas de BI (Power BI ou similares)
  • Conhecimento em estatística aplicada - análise descritiva, inferencial e modelagem preditiva
  • Vivência com processos de ETL , integração e limpeza de dados
  • Excel Avançado - tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas e análise de dados


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em Python ou R para análises estatísticas e automação
  • Experiência com modelagem preditiva e machine learning básico
  • Domínio em design de dashboards e storytelling com dados
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e data warehouses


Responsabilidades Principais:

• Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios em Power BI

• Realizar consultas SQL complexas para extração e análise de dados

• Garantir qualidade, integridade e consistência dos dados

• Apoiar na definição e monitoramento de KPIs e métricas operacionais

• Criar modelos estatísticos e análises preditivas

• Trabalhar com equipes de operações para identificar oportunidades de melhoria baseadas em dados

• Realizar análises estatísticas para suporte à tomada de decisão


Perfil do Candidato:

• Mentalidade analítica e orientada a dados

• Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights acionáveis

• Habilidades de comunicação para apresentar resultados

• Atenção a detalhes e precisão nos dados

• Proatividade na identificação de oportunidades


O que oferecemos:

• Oportunidade de atuar em projetos estratégicos

• Ambiente com foco em data-driven decision making

• Acesso a ferramentas modernas de BI e análise

• Plano de desenvolvimento profissional contínuo

• Benefícios competitivos de mercado

• Trabalho com grandes volumes de dados e desafios complexos


O que esperamos de você:


Ensino superior completo em TI ou áreas correlatas;


Se você acha que possui 75% ou até 90% do que estamos procurando e sabe que é capaz das responsabilidades e deveres desta função, encorajamos você a se candidatar! Isso mostrará sua disposição a se desenvolver, curiosidade para aprender e crescer profissional e pessoalmente.


O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo.


Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail
